name: Eren
source:
A strong-willed gyaru. She is considered to be the leaders of the girls.
She looks down on nerds and other "shady characters" and considers them creepy. Thus she treats them harshly.

Translated from https://www.dmm.co.jp/dc/doujin/-/detail/=/cid=d_242775/
